_readme: Append-only extension of UNOBTANIUM_DB. Merged at scraper load by _merge_parts_overlay(). Entries match existing DB rows by make + match keyword (parts carry their own yr_min/yr_max, so generation-split rows stay honest); unknown models create new rows. Written by hand (owner tips) and by scraper/research_parts.py (weekly LLM research run). 'researched' tracks which coverage groups the researcher already handled.
